method: Read all 45 dev questions and their empty conversation/context. Inspect frozen source passages matched by normalized academic-policy terms and relevant admission/curriculum scope. Distinguish missing referents, personal data, absence of requested policy, and unrelated near matches. Term scans aid attributable semantic decisions; zero term hits are not an exhaustive semantic absence theorem. No answers or held-out records used for these decisions.

groups.reason: Credit quantity has no named course, programme, semester or graduation target; empty context cannot resolve the referent. Do not guess one of the different source credit totals.
Second-year status alone does not identify which rule or entitlement is requested. No previous conversation supplies that rule.
Eligibility/consequences are unspecified: neither a target policy nor the personal facts needed to apply it are supplied.
No certificate type, score, date, issuer or target programme is supplied. The master's admission recognition tables do not establish this person's eligibility.

The indexed materials do not state the requested scholarship GPA or financial-support threshold. Master's admission GPA 3.2 and graduation valedictorian ranking are different policies; neither is scholarship eligibility.
No source states how an F/failed course affects academic encouragement scholarship. Examination sanctions and valedictorian awards do not supply this scholarship rule.
No source establishes a GPA threshold for academic warning; admissions GPA and curriculum GPA inclusion/exclusion notes are unrelated.
No source establishes academic warning from two failed courses in one semester. Examination misconduct consequences are not an academic-warning progression policy.
Curriculum notes specify which components enter GPA, but do not say whether retaking a course replaces the old grade or counts both attempts.
Master's admission conditions and programme-specific language outcomes are scoped rules. They cannot establish a single English standard applying to every 2025 intake programme.
The sources mention credit completion, GPA component exclusions, valedictorian selection and master's admission GPA. None states the requested minimum whole-course GPA for graduation.
The scoped files are general curricula, admissions, award and examination documents, not this person's transcript or marks. The query supplies no personal grade data.
A partnership curriculum's planned Credits per semester totals are a study schedule, not the minimum number a student may register. No source states the requested registration minimum.
No source gives a registration eligibility/cap rule for GPA 2.1 with one F. Scheduled semester totals cannot be used to authorize registration for 20 credits.
